title: Old Farm Pool

services.name: Pickleball
services.desc: Old Farm Pool has FOUR lighted courts for you to play Pickleball (two Pickleball only and two Paddle Tennis courts that can be used for Pickleball). At this time, the courts are available on a non-reserved, first come - first served basis. The two dedicated Pickleball courts are available daily from 5:30 AM - 11:00 PM. The Paddle Tennis courts may be used for Pickleball if they are not being used by Paddle Tennis players (Paddle Tennis players have priority on these two courts). During the year, there are Pickleball tournaments, league play, and clinics. These events will be announced and will have priority over open play. Pickleball Day Use Guest Passes are $10/person.Visitors may pay

services.name: Rental Instructions
services.desc: Clean up of the area is your responsibility. Please ensure pool members or the next rental group does not have a mess. When you reserve a space, you are committing to occupy prime real estate at the pool. The pool board members and staff make behind-the-scenes efforts to accommodate the reservation, not to mention you are denying other members the opportunity to rent the space. Please do not reserve “just in case” you want to use it. Reservations must be made at least 7 days before the event to allow the pool time to make any necessary staffing requirements. There are NO same-day reservations. Please contact membership with any questions about this. Please do not book reservations directly
